items.title: Explained | While US-China agreement offers trade relief, why firms may not reverse their costly supply-chain moves
items.summary: China has extended its suspension of restrictions on exports of key minerals to the US until Jan 27, 2027, easing supply concerns. But repeated trade negotiations have pushed businesses to diversify suppliers, often at higher cost, and many may retain those alternatives despite the extension.

items.title: Four oil tankers catch fire after hitting naval mines in Strait of Hormuz: Iran
items.summary: Four oil tankers exploded and caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz after striking naval mines. The Iranian Navy reported that two vessels had entered a restricted area, disabling their identification systems. Tanker operators are being warned against unauthorized routes due to the risk of explosions. Concurrently, the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations noted that three vessels were struck by unidentified projectiles.

items.title: Anant Ambani’s Vantara signs 10-year wildlife conservation agreement with Madagascar
items.summary: Vantara has signed a 10-year agreement with Madagascar's Ministry of Environment to enhance wildlife conservation and animal welfare. The MoU will facilitate the repatriation of seized animals and establish a wildlife rescue and rehabilitation center. Vantara aims to provide training and technical support to local authorities for wildlife management. The collaboration will focus on research and genetic profiling to aid animal rewilding efforts.

items.title: Maharashtra FDA cancels Pune firm's drug manufacturing licences over substandard, spurious medicines
items.summary: Maharashtra's FDA has revoked the manufacturing licenses of Inducare Pharmaceutical due to serious quality issues. The firm was found to have produced spurious drugs without the necessary permissions. Inspections revealed many violations of Good Manufacturing Practices and unsafe production conditions. Testing showed various drugs manufactured were below expected quality standards and posed health risks. This action reflects regulatory efforts to ensure drug safety and protect public health.

items.title: JSW Motors reveals new logo, prepares to enter India's passenger vehicle market
items.summary: JSW Motors Limited unveiled its brand identity, including a new logo that symbolizes its aspirations. The brand plans to launch its first product on December 3, which will showcase their vision for mobility. JSW Motors aims to provide world-class mobility solutions to Indian consumers while building local technological capabilities. The company's vehicles will be manufactured in Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar and sold through separate dealerships.

items.title: India and Netherlands looking at boosting cooperation in clean energy, shipbuilding: MEA
items.summary: India and the Netherlands are enhancing cooperation in several sectors including shipping and green hydrogen. External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar and Dutch counterpart Tom Berendsen met to discuss strengthening bilateral relations. They reviewed ongoing engagements across areas such as trade, technology, and maritime development. Both sides emphasized the significance of the India-EU Free Trade Agreement for economic growth.

items.title: Alliance Air to begin flight operations between Silchar, Imphal from November end: Assam CM
items.summary: Alliance Air is set to begin flight operations connecting Silchar and Imphal by the end of November. The flights will operate on Tuesdays and Thursdays using ATR-72 aircraft. This new air link aims to enhance tourism, trade, and cultural connections between Assam and Manipur. Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma expressed optimism about the benefits of this service. The initiative is expected to significantly contribute to the regional economy.

items.title: India among French giant Saint-Gobain's top 5 global markets; CEO sees more headroom
items.summary: Saint-Gobain has announced a significant investment of over Rs 11,000 crore in India for manufacturing. This investment aims to focus on sustainable building solutions and advanced technologies. Furthermore, the company is addressing the need for innovation and skill development in the construction sector. Additionally, Saint-Gobain sees India as a potential manufacturing hub for the Asia Pacific region. The group expresses confidence in India’s growing market opportunities over the coming decades.

items.title: Drug approval timelines may fall further with 1,500 new regulatory posts: CDSCO
items.summary: Drug approval timelines in India have reduced from over two years to under six months in recent years. The Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation is enhancing its regulatory capacity and implementing digital tools to further decrease this time. Measures have been taken to combat counterfeit drugs, with spurious drugs now accounting for only 0.2 percent of samples tested. The ongoing CPHI India 2026 exhibition highlights advancements in the pharmaceutical industry.

items.title: Keralam seeks Centre's help as oil firms refuse ethanol-free petrol samples
items.summary: Keralam's government has asked for the Centre's help in acquiring necessary ethanol-free petrol samples. State officials are concerned about ethanol's impact on automobile engines amid rising complaints. The request follows failed attempts to obtain necessary samples from oil companies for verification. Inspections were initiated after allegations of excess ethanol content in petrol surfaced in Karnataka. The state aims to ensure compliance with permissible ethanol limits in petrol distribution.

items.title: India's economic activity growth hits four-year high of 9% in October: Jefferies
items.summary: India's economic activity growth hit a four-year high of 9% year-on-year in October. The increase was largely attributed to strong industrial activity and a delayed festive season. However, rural demand indicators remained weak due to a subdued monsoon. While bank credit growth reached a nearly 12-year high, inflationary pressures intensified simultaneously. Overall, the report highlights a mixed outlook for future economic activity amidst varying consumer behaviors.

items.title: Why France is at risk of recession — and what could keep it out of one
items.summary: Bank of France Governor Emmanuel Moulin told CNBC he still expects growth, pointing to resilience in sectors including defense, aerospace and electricity.

items.summary: Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal and Karnataka account for nearly 62% of the increase in state borrowings, even as the Centre has trimmed its own FY27 borrowing programme.

items.summary: Nvidia had come under pressure from President Trump to reappoint Huang, whose comeback helped add $1tn to the company's stock value.

items.title: India, Canada 'very close' to conclude trade pact negotiations: Official
items.summary: Negotiators from India and Canada are engaging daily to finalize the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement negotiations. A sixth round of discussions took place recently, focusing on key areas such as trade and investment. Both countries aim to increase bilateral trade to USD 50 billion by 2030, after a decline in trade values. India is also working on a separate bilateral investment protection agreement with Canada.

items.title: India-EU free trade pact to open new opportunities for trade, investment: German state leader
items.summary: India and the European Union concluded negotiations on a Free Trade Agreement that is set to be finalized soon. Minister-President Olaf Lies of Lower Saxony emphasized the potential benefits for both Indian and German businesses. He mentioned cooperation in areas like digitalization and artificial intelligence as key prospects for collaboration. The partnership aims to enhance skilled workforce mobility with training programs for young Indians.
